assignment: 100% to the Office, single assignment; no other cost component

epoch_charge.amount: the full daily charge for each such day, no proration
epoch_charge.days: every UTC calendar day the EVALUATED epoch is open for any part of the day; ended_at is exclusive at exact midnight
epoch_charge.discovery: discovery books and discovery epochs are never charged
epoch_charge.known_when: the charge is a constant, so C is exact when the epoch closes at its look; only an epoch still open is pending
epoch_charge.office_wide_reporting: outside the verdict, each UTC day is charged exactly once
epoch_charge.restart_or_new_epoch_id: cannot drop a day; the charge attaches to the calendar day
epoch_charge.shared_day: a day shared by two consecutive evaluated epochs costs each of them in full

epoch_cost: C = sum over the UTC days the evaluated epoch is open for any part of 800 / days_in_month(day)
ops_only: usage fields may be recorded for operations visibility and never enter cost
source: operator order 2026-10-28 ~17:0xZ relayed by Alpha: Office costs are a flat 800 USD per month
